patch_name: E-Learning BSI Portable ChatGPT + Live Data Guard
description: Adds a compact BSI-only portable ChatGPT workflow inside the existing class UI: download locked instruction, upload JSON, full preflight preview, explicit apply, history, and live-data protection. It does not alter the Dosen class UI and never overwrites attendance, submissions, grades, feedback, KRS, schedules, teachers, or real execution dates.
